summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Talaş CNC mobile app (offline-first PWA). Backend API: 54/54 tests passed. Frontend UI: 40+ tests passed with exact mockup value matches. All core features working: live calculations (Freze/Torna/Matkap), machine limits with checkbox control, material library (24 materials), unit system toggle (Metric/Imperial), PWA offline capability, localStorage persistence.

backend_issues.notes: All backend endpoints working perfectly. All calculations return exact expected values matching Phase 1 POC (92/92 tests).
